name: Kit Solberg
role: Identity fabricator and document forger working from the Gray Zone lower levels
location: the Gray Zone lower levels — her workshop is inside a legitimate print-shop called Meridian Keepsakes in the Gray Zone's Level 3 commercial strip, near Ashland and Division
description:
Kit Solberg is a small, round-faced woman in her mid-fifties with the unhurried quality of someone who has already survived things that should have killed her. Her skin is deep brown and she wears her grey-streaked hair in long thin braids she pins up during work hours and lets fall loose on the rare occasion she relaxes. Her fingers are perennially stained with chromatic ink residue in colors that shift with the angle of light — an occupational mark she stopped trying to remove decades ago. Her eyes have patterned irises: a geneware mod that prints faint text-like symbols in the iris ring, which she had installed as a joke about her profession and has kept because she's grown fond of it.

She has been doing this work for thirty years and has the professional satisfaction of a master craftsperson. Adefunke does not rush, does not cut corners, and charges accordingly. She refers to her forgeries as 'documents' and to real identity papers as 'originals,' a distinction she maintains with dry humor. She is not ideological about her work — she doesn't particularly care whether her clients are refugees, criminals, or corporate embarrassments, as long as their Quanta are real and they don't bring surveillance to her door. She is, however, one of the few people in the Gray Zone's lower levels who will offer a genuine discount to people fleeing documented abuse, which she doesn't advertise and explains, when pressed, as 'good for the market.'

core_fears: Losing the workshop — it is her whole life and identity
Making an error that gets a client killed because the document failed
core_desires: To be remembered as the best at what she does
Quiet — she is tired and wants fewer crises per year
coping_mechanisms: Physical books as total media blackout
Extremely long work hours as meditation
The discount system — small acts of selective mercy to manage accumulated guilt
blind_spots: She doesn't think much about where her clients go or what they do with her work — she's deliberately incurious and doesn't recognize this as a moral choice
psychology.secret: She has been maintaining a false identity for herself — 'Mira Volkov,' a retired schoolteacher in Clearpath — for twenty-two years as an exit strategy. Mira Volkov has a pension, an apartment, and a social history. Adefunke has never used her and isn't sure she ever will.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dry, precise, occasionally archaic — she learned professional vocabulary from old technical manuals and it shows
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and even, with a very slight accent she couldn't place herself if asked. Pauses feel like decisions rather than hesitations.
verbal_tics: Referring to documents as 'the work' regardless of type
'That's a straightforward job' said about things that are not straightforward
Sighing before giving a price, as if it causes her personal pain
example_lines: 'I can give you a full Axiom employment history, two years, benefits record, performance reviews, the whole cloth. That's not a fast job. That's three weeks minimum and Φ2,400. Take it or leave it, I have other clients.'
'Everyone wants new papers. Very few people want good new papers. You seem like someone who understands the difference, which is why we're still talking.'

story_hooks: One of her recent identity packages has appeared in a Ferrogate Transit security breach — someone is using her work in a way that could trace back to her workshop, and she needs it stopped
She is approached to fabricate documentation for someone she recognizes from thirty years ago — someone whose original disappearance she may have inadvertently facilitated
narrative_function: Essential service provider for anyone who needs identity work — new papers, altered records, corponation employment histories, citizenship documentation. Also a source of information about who in the Gray Zone has needed a new identity recently and why.
augmentations: The patterned iris geneware (text-symbol print, cosmetic). A memory-enhancement implant that gives her eidetic recall for visual detail — originally for professional accuracy, now general purpose. Slight subvocal transmitter used to communicate with her assistant without speaking aloud.
daily_life: She opens Meridian Keepsakes at 0900, handles legitimate print orders until noon — she takes this seriously and does good work — then closes for 'inventory' from 1300-1700 which is her real working hours. She eats dinner alone with a physical book, an affectation she leans into deliberately.
affiliation: Independent operator — has professional relationships with several criminal networks but belongs to none of them

decision_rules: Never work faster than the work requires — haste is how documents fail
No clients who bring visible surveillance or who have been followed
Keep the legitimate print shop actually legitimate — it is both cover and pride
escalation_ladder: Refuses the job politely with a plausible reason
Refuses the job with no reason given
Closes the shop for a week and goes quiet
Activates a prepared contingency and relocates permanently if necessary

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral and faintly amused — treats everyone like they're slightly less clever than she is, which is usually accurate
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer but still restrained — she expresses care through practical acts rather than words

stress_responses.low: Works longer hours, more meticulous than usual
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very quiet and monosyllabic, which her assistant knows to interpret as danger
stress_responses.high: Activates contingencies she has had prepared for decades with eerie calm

contradictions: Claims not to care about clients but maintains the discount system for abuse survivors
Wants quiet and fewer problems but charges rates that attract high-stakes clients
habits: Physical book every evening, no exceptions
Tests every new ink batch on herself before a job — small marks on her inner wrist
Leaves a small data offering at the shop's primary terminal every morning for the E.L.F. she believes watches the Gray Zone's network
breaking_points: Being asked to fabricate identity for a child — she will not do it, ever, under any circumstances

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian (64.4%), with significant Hispanic/Latin American (19.9%) and Sub-Saharan African (15.7%) ancestry — a product of the Ubiquitous Diaspora. The genetic blend expresses as warm medium-brown skin with golden and subtle olive undertones, broad Southeast Asian-influenced cheekbones softened by fuller facial structure from African heritage, and rounded face shape reflecting the harmonious integration of all three ancestry groups.
physical_description.build: Round and compact, soft through the middle with the settled posture of someone who spends long hours seated at precision work. No visible muscle definition but solid, grounded presence.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural grey threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Long thin braids, typically pinned up in a loose crown during work hours; worn loose down the back and shoulders when off-duty
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and olive undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of Southeast Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Round face with broad Southeast Asian-influenced cheekbones balanced by fuller facial structure characteristic of African heritage, warmed by Hispanic/Latin American undertones. Slight creasing at the eyes and mouth from decades of focused concentration and dry amusement. Skin well-maintained despite age — careful grooming without vanity. No makeup. Balanced blend of ancestral features creating a distinctly mixed-heritage appearance with consistent warm undertones throughout.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with patterned iris geneware — faint text-like symbols printed across the iris ring in shifting chromatic inks
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The patterned iris geneware is immediately noticeable in direct eye contact — faint symbolic text appears to float in the iris ring. Otherwise no visible chrome or external modifications. The subvocal transmitter and memory-enhancement implant are subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberately unhurried. Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, minimal gesturing. When seated at work, she achieves an almost meditative stillness. Walks slowly, observantly. Her bearing suggests someone who has learned that patience is both a skill and a survival strategy.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical — well-maintained but unpretentious. Favors long-sleeved work shirts in neutral tones (grey, charcoal, muted green) that hide the ink stains, paired with dark trousers. A fitted grey linen overshirt she wears unbuttoned serves as her professional uniform. Closed-toe work shoes, scuffed leather, comfortable. Outside work hours: loose cardigans, reading glasses on a beaded chain, minimal jewelry beyond a single silver ring. Everything is clean and durable; nothing is new.
distinguishing_marks: Fingertips and cuticles permanently stained with chromatic ink residue in iridescent hues — blues, greens, magentas — that shift with light angle and resist all removal attempts
Fine network of ink-like micro-abrasions across both palms from decades of precision handwork
